description: PROP-E5 explicitly mandates structured analysis of THREE source languages: (i) Python via ast, (ii) Shell via bash -n + shellcheck --format=json, (iii) JS/TS via acorn or tree-sitter. The impl's adversary_path_intersect (lib/spawn_pin.py:193) only walks Python AST. There is no bash shellcheck branch and no JS tree-sitter branch. The fallback at line 216 ('any(s in source for s in surface_set)') reduces non-Python to substring grep — the EXACT v3 grep clause that ROUND-3-002 declared a downgrade. Spec text: 'the v3 grep clause was a downgrade'. Impl regresses to grep for 2 of 3 languages. Shell scripts in spawn-surface (adversary-daily.sh, the missing loop-*.sh) cannot be meaningfully analyzed.

evidence.snippet: try: tree = ast.parse(source) except SyntaxError: return any(s in source for s in surface_set)  # ← shell + JS hit this fallback
